entities.summary: Dr. Lori Glaze is an American scientist and is the deputy associate administrator for NASA’s Exploration Systems Development Mission Directorate (ESDMD). In this role, she shares responsibility for leadership and management of human spaceflight development and operations related to the agency’s Artemis program to explore the Moon for scientific discovery and technology advancement, learning how to live and work on another world as we prepare for human missions to Mars. She was previously the director of NASA's Science Mission Directorate's Planetary Science Division.
